listen_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to bind to. Each entry may include optional address and port.

address.description: IP address to bind to (leave empty for default interface address)

key_file.description: Path to the shared key file for authentication (must be readable only by root)

backends.description: Backend virtualization drivers to use. Common: libvirt, xen.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for backend operations

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (0 = quiet, 7 = debug). Recommended: 4 (info).

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use (e.g., daemon, local0)

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for remote fence operations (recommended for production)

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS server certificate (PEM format)

tls_key.description: Path to TLS server private key (PEM format)

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying clients (PEM format)

socket_path.description: Unix domain socket path for local fence agent communication

default_timeout.description: Default operation timeout in seconds for fencing actions
